List internal or built-in objects.

By default, shows only built-in or internal objects (excludes regular public objects).
Use --built-in to filter for only built-in instances.
Use --internal to filter for only internal objects (visibility: internal).
Use --all to show all objects including regular public ones.

If no kind is specified, lists all internal/built-in objects across all kinds.

Flags:
    --all
      Show all objects (including regular public objects)
    --built-in
      Filter for built-in instances only
    --count
      Only return the count
    --filter <stringArray> (default: [])
      Filter by field (field=value or field:value, multiple allowed)
    --group-by <string>
      Field to group results by
    --group-limit <int> (default: 0)
      Max items per group when using --group-by (0 = no limit)
    --ids-only
      Show only object IDs (one per line)
    --internal
      Filter for internal objects (visibility: internal) only
    --limit <int> (default: 0)
      Pagination limit (0 = no limit)
    --offset <int> (default: 0)
      Pagination offset
    --sort-asc (default: true)
      Sort ascending (default true)
    --sort-by <string>
      Field to sort by

  List all built-in and internal objects (across all kinds)
  zqk internal list
  List only built-in objects (across all kinds)
  zqk internal list --built-in
  List built-in and internal components only
  zqk internal list component
  List only built-in component types
  zqk internal list component --built-in
  List internal objects only
  zqk internal list lifecycle --internal
  List all objects (including regular public ones)
  zqk internal list backlog_item --all

Usage:
  zqk internal list [kind] [flags]

Flags:
      --all                     Show all objects (including regular public objects)
      --built-in                Filter for built-in instances only
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
      --count                   Only return the count
      --filter stringArray      Filter by field (field=value or field:value, multiple allowed)
      --format string           Output format: table | json | yaml (default "table")
      --group-by string         Field to group results by
      --group-limit int         Max items per group when using --group-by (0 = no limit)
      --ids-only                Show only object IDs (one per line)
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
      --internal                Filter for internal objects (visibility: internal) only
      --limit int               Pagination limit (0 = no limit)
      --offset int              Pagination offset
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --sort-asc                Sort ascending (default true) (default true)
      --sort-by string          Field to sort by
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
